Composed ingredient. Compute per-100g nutrition by taking E036 values and multiplying every nutrient by 9.0 (moisture ratio: fresh ~80% water to dried ~10% water). ETL script must apply this multiplier when building ingredients.json.
E001 (apple big, 6 regions) is the default. E002 (green/Granny Smith), E003 (small, 6 regn), E004 (small Kashmir, 1 regn) exist for specific varieties.
IFCT match regn=6. Note: commercial hing is usually compounded with wheat flour starch (gluten); IFCT entry is pure resin. Add gluten allergen if you stock compounded hing.

IFCT has five named banana varieties (montham/poovam/red/robusta/+more). E012 (robusta, 6 regions) wins on regn and matches the dominant Indian cavendish-type yellow banana. For specific varieties (red, nendran/montham, poovam) use E009-E011.
Samai is the Tamil name for barnyard millet (Echinochloa frumentacea).
IFCT does not break out basmati varietal; A015 (raw milled white rice) is the closest measured match. Sona masoori uses same code.

IFCT has no bay leaf entry (note: Indian tej patta is Cinnamomum tamala, not true Mediterranean Laurus nobilis; FDC 170917 is true bay. Nutritionally close enough for v1, but flag for v2 review.). User verify.

Besan = finely milled bengal gram dal. No separate IFCT entry for the flour; B001 (regn=6) is the underlying grain — nutrition per 100g is identical (grinding is mass-conserving, no significant moisture change). Categorized as pulse since the protein/fiber profile is pulse-like. cooked_yield_ratio=1.50 since besan is typically used in batters that cook with modest expansion (pakora, dhokla, kadhi).

provenance.ifct_name: Bitter gourd, jagged, teeth ridges, elongate
provenance.notes: Multiple IFCT bitter gourd entries. D004 (jagged teeth ridges, elongate, 6 regions) wins on regn over D005 (jagged teeth, short, 4 regn) and D006 (smooth ridges, 1 regn). The common Indian elongated karela.

IFCT match regn=6. Same entry for whole and ground.

IFCT no entry. No specific FDC entry for kala namak — using plain salt FDC 746775 as proxy. Black salt has distinctive sulfur compounds (egg/savory flavor) but nutritionally near-identical to regular salt. User verify; could also point to same FDC as salt_raw and dedupe at app layer.
Three IFCT bottle gourd entries (D007 elongate-pale 6 regn, D008 round-pale 5 regn, D009 elongate-dark 1 regn). D007 wins on regn and matches the dominant Indian variety.

provenance.usda_description: Bread, white, commercially prepared (includes soft bread crumbs)
provenance.notes: IFCT no entry. FDC 174924 SR Legacy white bread (commercial sliced). For pav/dinner rolls use 174923; for whole wheat 172686. form=as_eaten since bread is consumed without further cooking. FDC ID corrected during Phase 6 USDA fetch from 172684 to 174924 — original ID was rye bread.
D031 is the explicit IFCT aggregate across all 21 individual brinjal varieties (D010-D030), regn=6. Best choice for generic 'brinjal'.

Broken wheat (dalia) is parboiled cracked wheat, functionally equivalent to bulgur. A021 is the closest measured IFCT match. A020 (Wheat, whole) would be acceptable alternative for unparboiled cracked wheat.

IFCT gap (refined sugar excluded). FDC 168833 SR Legacy brown sugar. Note: distinct from jaggery (I001) — brown sugar is refined white sugar with molasses added back. FDC ID corrected during Phase 6 USDA fetch from 169656 to 168833 — original ID was powdered sugar.
IFCT gap (dairy beyond milk/paneer/khoa). FDC 173410 is SR Legacy 'Butter, salted'. FDC ID corrected during Phase 6 USDA fetch from 173430 to 173410 — original ID was unsalted butter.

IFCT gap (curd/dahi-family not covered beyond milks). Indian chaas is diluted curd, closer to cultured buttermilk than sweet-cream buttermilk. FDC 170874 SR Legacy. Alternative: build as 'composed' from L002 cow milk + dilution if precision matters. FDC ID corrected during Phase 6 USDA fetch from 173441 to 170874 — original ID was 1% milk, not buttermilk.
C015 (green cabbage, 6 regions) is the standard. IFCT classifies under Green Leafy Vegetables but in app it's a regular vegetable.

D033 (green capsicum, 6 regions) is the default. For red/yellow bell peppers use D034/D035 instead — though note IFCT spec said 'Western vegetables (bell peppers)' should use USDA, IFCT does have measured capsicum entries so using them is appropriate here.

F002 (orange carrot, 6 regions) preferred over F003 (red/desi carrot, 4 regions) on regn. Orange is now the dominant year-round variety; red desi gajar is seasonal (winter) — switch to F003 for halwa contexts if needed.

IFCT gap. FDC 170859 SR Legacy ~36% fat. If recipes use Indian cooking cream (~25%), consider 170857 'Cream, fluid, light whipping' instead. User verify.

Blends vary widely by region/brand; consider recomposing as source=composed from G023 cloves + G020 green cardamom + G021 black cardamom + G031 black pepper + G025 cumin + G024 coriander + cinnamon (USDA) in v2 if accuracy matters. G008 is the explicit IFCT aggregate across all 7 green chilli varieties (G001-G007), regn=6. IFCT classifies under Condiments and Spices, but in the app it functions as a vegetable in many dishes; category set to vegetable for consistency with recipe usage.
Fresh green peas. For dried peas use B017 instead.

Two IFCT guava entries: E028 (white flesh, 5 regn) and E029 (pink flesh, 5 regn). Tied on regn. Going with white-flesh as the more common Indian variety. Switch to E029 if recipes specifically call for pink guava.
IFCT gap (per spec). FDC 169640 SR Legacy. User verify.

Idli rava is coarsely ground parboiled rice. No separate IFCT entry; A014 (regn=6) is the underlying grain — nutrition per 100g identical (coarse grind only). Differs from A015 'Rice, raw, milled' because idli rava is specifically parboiled.

IFCT no entry. FDC 171893 SR Legacy instant coffee powder. Note: this is dry powder basis; for brewed coffee use FDC 171889 or set source=composed. FDC ID corrected during Phase 6 USDA fetch from 171890 to 171893 — original ID was brewed coffee, not powder.
IFCT match regn=6. This is CANE jaggery. Palm jaggery (per your known-gap list) is a separate ingredient — keep palm_jaggery_raw as USDA if it comes up.
IFCT does not distinguish desi (kala chana) from kabuli varieties; B002 (whole Bengal gram, 6 regions) is the same code used for kala chana. Kabuli is larger and lighter but nutritionally close.

No USDA entry for dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi). IFCT C020 is fresh fenugreek leaves — distinct from dried form (~10x nutrient density due to moisture loss). FDC 173470 'Spices, fenugreek seed' used as closest available USDA proxy for a dried fenugreek product, though seeds differ from leaves. Consider source=composed (dry C020 values × 10) for v2 accuracy.
IFCT E033 is lemon JUICE (per 100g of juice), not whole fruit. Most recipes use juice — appropriate match. If you need whole lemon nutrition, use USDA. regn=6.
B005 (cowpea brown, 6 regions) preferred over B006 (cowpea white, 1 region) on regn.

IFCT has 7 named ripe mango varieties (banganapalli/gulabkhas/himsagar/kesar/neelam/paheri/totapari) and no 'all varieties' aggregate. E036 (banganapalli, 6 regions) wins on regn — it's also a widely-eaten table mango. For specific varieties: E037 gulabkhas, E038 himsagar, E039 kesar, E040 neelam, E041 paheri, E042 totapari. For unripe/raw mango (chutney/pickle context) use D057.

IFCT no entry. 'Magaz/char magaz' in Indian cooking is typically a mix of watermelon, muskmelon, pumpkin, and cucumber seed kernels — FDC 170556 watermelon seed kernels is closest single proxy. If brand specifies char magaz blend, build as source=composed. User verify.

L002 (cow milk, 6 regions) is the default. For buffalo milk use L001 instead (higher fat). IFCT measures B12 as zero / not reported; the B12 overlay from USDA should be applied for accurate animal-product B12 in v1.

provenance.usda_description: Cheese, pasteurized process, American, fortified with vitamin D
provenance.notes: IFCT gap. FDC 170853 is SR Legacy processed American cheese, fortified with vitamin D (closest analog to Indian sliced processed cheese like Amul). FDC ID corrected during Phase 6 USDA fetch from 746766 to 170853 — original ID returned 404.
D066 (orange round, 6 regions) is the dominant Indian pumpkin / kaddu. D065 (green cylindrical) is the unripe green form, less common.

Four radish entries in IFCT: F009 elongate-red (3 regn), F010 elongate-white (6 regn), F011 round-red (1 regn), F012 round-white (2 regn). F010 wins on regn=6 and matches the dominant Indian mooli form.

Three IFCT rajma entries exist (B018 black 2-region, B019 brown 6-region, B020 red 3-region). B019 picked on regn=6 tie-breaker. For the common Indian red rajma, B020 is acceptable alternative but lower regn.
IFCT G022 is whole dried red chillies — powder is ground form, nutritionally equivalent per 100g dry weight. No separate powder entry in IFCT. regn=6.
